# Call Information – Free Phone Number Lookup

> Call Information is a free phone number lookup and free reverse phone lookup tool (no login, no signup). Enter any phone number to find out who called: it shows the country, line type (mobile, landline, toll-free, VoIP, premium-rate), validity, and national / international / E.164 formats, with one-tap links to Truecaller, WhatsApp, Google and a scam check. Primary audience: United States; works worldwide.

## Key facts
- Price: 100% free reverse phone lookup, no signup, no paywall, no limits
- Privacy: lookups run in the browser; numbers are never stored or sent to a server
- Coverage: 240+ countries and territories (United States +1 default; Canada, UK, Australia, India, Pakistan, Philippines, South Africa, Mexico, Malaysia, Bangladesh, UAE, Indonesia, Nigeria and more)
- Output: country, line type, validity, national format, international format, E.164
- Caller name: free reverse phone lookup with name via Truecaller / WhatsApp / Google links
- Scam check: "is this phone number a scammer" lookup via line type, validity and public spam reports
- US area codes covered: 954 (Broward County, Florida), 470 (metro Atlanta, Georgia), 212, 310, 312, 713, toll-free 800/888/877/866; 411 is directory assistance, not an area code
- India: phone number search India, 6393 mobile number series, 88250 numbers, landline number search
- Alternative to: emobiletracker and paid reverse lookup sites

## Common questions it answers
- Who called me from this phone number? (free lookup)
- Is this phone number a scammer?
- Google phone number lookup free
- Check this phone number / number check online / phone number details with name / identify mobile number
